entities.name: Caesar DePaço
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: César Manuel Cardoso Matos do Paço, also known as Caesar DePaço, is a Portuguese businessman. He was an honorary consul for both Portugal and Cape Verde in the United States, in Palm Coast, Florida. DePaço is the chief executive officer of Summit Nutritionals International, a food industry company.
